rows.ARS:
Red blend Miniature.
Exhibition name: Wonderful News
rows.Origin:
Bred by Chris Jones (United Kingdom, before 1994).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2001 as 'Wonderful News'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, white center. None / no fragrance. Semi-double (9-16 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Few or no prickles/thorns.

Height: up to 16" (up to 40cm). Width: up to 30" (up to 75cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or container rose. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
